steps.instruction: Read the hours and minutes at the center and the small seconds at nine.
Lift the front glazing in this display to reveal the open dial.
Separate the chapter ring to expose the movement perimeter.
Follow the mainspring barrel through the wheel train to the small-seconds pivot.
The pallet fork meters the escape wheel. The balance and hairspring set the rhythm.
Return the regulating parts to their display position.
Return the chapter ring to the case.
Reassemble the front glazing and return to the watch.
